name: Timo Menzel
topics: 3D Scanning, Avatar Personalization & Real-Time Facial Animation
description: I am a research associate and PhD candidate at TU Dortmund University, specializing in 3D avatar scanning and personalization using consumer hardware. I develop practical pipelines that transform smartphone captures into realistic full-body avatars and expressive facial animations for VR and real-time applications. I am looking to apply my expertise in graphics engineering and real-time systems to industry, contributing to projects in computer graphics, digital humans, or interactive 3D applications.
